quote: Riverside Clinic will host the Project Atlas pilot.
conclusion: Riverside Clinic hosts the Project Atlas pilot.

quote: The pilot starts on 2026-03-02 and runs for six weeks.
conclusion: The pilot starts on 2026-03-02 and is planned to run six weeks.

quote: The pilot budget is capped at 40 hours of support per week.
conclusion: Support for the pilot is capped at 40 hours a week.

quote: Twenty staff members at Riverside Clinic will use the new scheduling screens during the pilot.
conclusion: Twenty Riverside Clinic staff use the new scheduling screens in the pilot.

quote: Riverside Clinic has onboarded 12 of the 20 planned users.
conclusion: After week 1, 12 of the 20 planned users are onboarded.

quote: The data export is delayed until 2026-03-20 because the test server is being replaced.
conclusion: The data export moves to 2026-03-20 while the test server is replaced.

quote: The steering group approved extending the pilot by two weeks, to 2026-04-27.
conclusion: The pilot is extended by two weeks, to 2026-04-27.

quote: The support budget stays at 40 hours per week for the extra two weeks.
conclusion: The 40-hour weekly support cap also covers the extension.

quote: The integration lead owns the data export and reports on it at the next meeting.
conclusion: The integration lead owns the data export.
